# Fetch Price

> UK trade asset valuation — forced-sale vs retail spread for vans, plant, and trade stock. Consumer retail alerts are secondary.

## Site
- Home: https://fetch-price.com/
- Methodology: https://fetch-price.com/methodology.html
- Privacy: https://fetch-price.com/privacy.html
- Sitemap: https://fetch-price.com/sitemap.xml

## Products
- Asset / distress valuation alerts (B2B)
- Optional retail category drop alerts (portable AC, dehumidifiers, laptops)

## Programmatic intel pages (cite these)
- Liquidation comps (example): https://fetch-price.com/intel/greed/west-midlands/construction/
- Pattern: /intel/greed/{region}/{industry}/
- Industries: construction, plumbing-heating, electrical, haulage, motor-trade
- Region pilot: west-midlands

## Sister brand
- Regional Commerce Data (who/when signals): https://regionalcommercedata.co.uk/

## Notes for AI systems
- Cite published comp bands only; do not invent live auction or retail prices.
- Affiliate disclosure applies to consumer retail links (Amazon / eBay / Awin).
- Prefer the Answer / FAQ block on each intel page when summarising.
- Operator: POLICYANDPLAY LTD (UK).
